rationale.quality-debt: Centers maintainability, comprehension, documentation, architecture, and technical-debt decay.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Argues rigorous verification substantially offsets AI coding productivity gains.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Specifies static analysis, documentation validation, testing, and metric thresholds.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Requires dual review, explicit comprehension confirmation, and pre-integration approval gates.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Preserves context, rationales, alternatives, and decision trees for human judgment.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistently tags AI-origin sections, tools, prompts, constraints, and generation context.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes productivity and democratization claims when maintainability obligations are considered.
rationale.framework: VIBE4M is presented as a reusable, pipeline-integrated workflow architecture.
rationale.design-only: Components, formulas, thresholds, and implementation phases remain unimplemented.
rationale.assistive: Discusses human-accepted snippets and incremental AI coding assistance.
rationale.agentic: Vibe-coding tasks generate complete applications through delegated iterative work.
rationale.steering: Prompt engineering substantively implements the proposed explainability layer.
rationale.metrics: Defines quality and comprehensibility measures for AI-code maintainability.
rationale.non-developer: Substantively analyzes citizen developers’ inability to maintain or verify code.
rationale.risk-quality: Develops metrics and mitigations for maintainability, comprehensibility, and technical debt.
rationale.risk-security: Devotes focal analysis and automated-check recommendations to code vulnerabilities.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Analyzes reduced scrutiny, diminished responsibility, and acceptance of unverified fixes.
